topic: CN-TT v4 -- the current, active Hs engine (tile-native; reference implementation of HUF-STD-002 Tensor Train).
purpose: Local node for the current engine: how it is built, how to run it, what it emits, and the link up to the control chain.
paths_note: key_files relative to THIS folder; join_the_chain relative to the Hs repo root.

specific_knowledge.what: CN-TT v4 is the live engine (supersedes the archived CNT v3.2.0 / CNQ v2.0.0 oracle). 4 hash-linked links: L1 ingest+treat+calibrate -> L2 geometry (closure, CLR, Helmert-ILR, D=4 quaternion) -> L3 tile/atlas -> L4 navigate+emit. Modular Stages = control point + test point + hash-cacheable unit. Run: python HCI-CNTT/run_cntt.py <composition.csv> -o out.json.
key_results: Tier 1: bit-identical to the frozen oracle on real Backblaze data (only engine-wide diff = atan2 angle ~5e-11 deg); self-tests green
Tier 1: lossless tiling (D=16-from-D=4 exact); cross-platform determinism contract (stable_hash to 1e-12)

Tier 1: navigation family per step (k_eff, helmsman, tv, regime, regime_boundaries), helmsman family, attractor fit, depth tower, EITT; SS-CCC-LLL diagnostic codes incl. automated NULL flag; internal-vs-external shock (FDIR); stage lifecycle (READY/RUNNING/HALTED/...)
specific_knowledge.claim_tiers: Tier 1 = the engine outputs + parity + self-tests; Tier 2 = the control-surface/interop design; Tier 3 = corpus-wide parity harness (P3) + config layer (to build).

bring_your_own_ai: To verify: run engine/self_test/run_self_test.py and modular_self_test.py; reproduce parity via experiments/backblaze_v4_parity_2026-06/. Read-only context; governance + claim-tiers apply.
governance: HUF-STD-001; the frozen oracle (HCI-CNT/engine/cnt.py, HCI-CNQ/engine/cnq.py) + schemas + INV catalog are locked; v4 is additive. No AI commits.
